changelog:
Talken 2.7

✨ New:
- Personas: show a different name, about and photo to different people. Create up to 5, assign contacts to each, and everyone else keeps seeing your default profile. Leave any field blank and it simply inherits your default.
- Crop photos inside Talken: profile pictures, persona photos and images you send now open a real crop editor with zoom, a rule-of-thirds grid and ratio presets. Your original file is never modified.
- Smarter photo sizes: large photos are shrunk before sending, cutting your upload and every recipient's download. You can see exactly what will be sent, switch it off for any single photo, or set the default in Settings → Chats & Messages.

🐛 Fixed:
- Photos no longer sometimes render blown-up in chat, and thumbnails are cropped instead of squashed.
- Scrolling a chat full of photos is much smoother — images are no longer fully decoded twice on every repaint.
- A contact's picture no longer appears zoomed after switching from a chat that had a photo.
- Your own "message yourself" chat now always shows as online.

🎨 Polish:
- Profile changes publish automatically the moment you make them — no confirm button.
- The attachment screen now uses the whole window and asks before discarding.
- Closing to the tray is silent.

📝 Notes:
Personas are resolved without the server ever learning who your contacts are. Thanks for using Talken!
